samples.summary: Merge geometry/propagation logic added inline in `moveRangeTo` instead of the existing `merging.ts` helper module. The repo already factors every other merge transformation into `packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/merging.ts` (`shiftMerge`/`shiftMergeMap`, `moveMerge`/`moveMergeMap`, `isMergeSplitByMove`, `toMergeRange`), and `moveCells` calls `isMergeSplitByMove` + `moveMergeMap` rather than open-coding containment/translation. A `translateMerge`/`isMergeSplitByRangeMove` pair in `merging.ts` would match the established layering and be unit-testable in isolation.
samples.evidence: sheet.ts:2293-2303 and 2369-2394 compute containment and anchor+delta translation inline; merging.ts:103-195 holds the analogous helpers for the row/column paths.

samples.summary: The covered-cell clearing loop duplicates the body of `mergeSelection` (sheet.ts:4306-4318) almost verbatim (get cell → keep `s` only if non-empty → else delete). The invariant it maintains is the same one, so a shared private helper (e.g. `clearMergeCoveredCells(anchor, span)`) would keep the two enforcement sites from drifting.
samples.evidence: sheet.ts:2382-2393 vs sheet.ts:4306-4318 — identical style-preserving clear logic.

samples.summary: The 'Merged Cell Model' section still does not record the invariant this change now depends on and enforces in a second place: covered cells hold no content (style-only cells are kept, values/formulas dropped). The doc only says covered cells are not persisted as merge metadata and that reads normalize to the anchor. Since the drag-move path now clears destination cells to uphold that invariant, the canonical model section is the right place to state it.
searchedFor: Grep -i 'merge' across docs/design (no dedicated sheets merge doc exists)

samples.summary: Rejection is a silent void return, so the view layer cannot distinguish 'moved' from 'refused'. `moveRangeTo` returns `Promise<void>` and the drag-drop completion handler just clears the preview and re-renders, so a user who drops onto/from a partially covered merge sees the drag simply vanish with no feedback. Sibling merge operations (`mergeSelection`, `unmergeSelection`) return a boolean precisely so callers can react; a boolean result here would keep the API consistent and leave room for a toast later. (Design-doc text records the no-op behavior, so this is a taste/consistency point, not an unmet criterion.)
samples.evidence: sheet.ts:2295/2302 `return;` on rejection; worksheet.ts:4309-4314 ignores the result; sheet.ts:4289/4343 return booleans.
